verdict.rationale: Paddle's first-party AI tooling says agents can "process customer refunds" in natural language. Its MCP server runs a codemode interface that chains real Paddle API calls, which implies a refund-capable API, and reconciliation docs reference transaction "adjustments". There is no direct refund documentation, though. Missing for 10: an explicit refund/adjustment API reference, evidence of partial (line-item or amount) versus full refunds, evidence of dashboard-initiated refunds, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
